packages/agent-runner/src/codex.ts: The client name the runner gives Codex's app server; the runner's bundle reaches no `@repo/features`, so it cannot read `PRODUCT_NAME`.
apps/mobile/app.config.ts: The app's display name. Expo evaluates this file under Node's own resolver when it generates the native project, and that resolver follows no `@repo` door to the `.ts` beside its `.js`, so it cannot import `PRODUCT_NAME`.
